judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` using `ajv` with `WeakMap` caching and safe error formatting, though it uses `import Ajv from 'ajv'` (which can cause ESM/TypeScript interop issues compared to the reference's `import {Ajv} from 'ajv'`) and leaves an internal `.lore/dod.md` tracking file in the tree. However, the candidate stopped partway through its own task list and missed roughly half of the ticket's acceptance criteria. Specifically, it failed to update `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `README.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, and its `CHANGELOG.md` entry only covers registration-time schema compilation rather than execution-time validation and the required migration note. Additionally, most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, static compilation caching, unknown tool throw) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were never written, leaving the extra tests in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file and several spec statements unlinked.
